webhooks.detail: NMI gateway (Paygent is NMI-powered; no Paygent-own docs found) lets merchants subscribe endpoints to gateway events (transaction, recurring, settlement, chargeback) via Merchant Portal > Settings > Webhooks.

evidence.quote: Each endpoint can be subscribed to specific events that happen in the gateway.

sandbox.detail: Sandbox keys and EMV sandbox need commercial relationship with NMI; per-account Test Mode toggle exists in merchant portal (needs a merchant account). No free self-serve dev account found.

evidence.quote: Registration with the EMV Sandbox environment is possible following commercial relationship with NMI.

rate_limits.summary: Rate limits exist but no numeric limit; Payment API returns response_code 301 'Rate limit exceeded', system-wide HTTP 429

evidence.quote: In order to ensure the platform is available for everyone, in very rare cases, some users may encounter rate limits.
For new integrations, start with the Payment Component and NMI REST API guides, API reference, SDKs, and recipes.
Import the API Postman Collection to start integrating today.
